nodes.label: SVG Vector Structure with Gradients and Filters
nodes.norm_label: svg vector structure with gradients and filters

nodes.label: Test mode silent (telegram_paused)
nodes.rationale: Shared silent-test toggle drops automatic events by marking claimed outbox rows processed so nothing piles up; test-notify and send-invoice intentionally ignore the flag for self-verification.

nodes.label: Notification recipients events merge rule
nodes.rationale: Actor is not notified, other partner gets DM plus push; same-order events in one batch merge to one DM/push to avoid spam; lock-screen-safe push text contains no PII or amounts.

nodes.label: Outbox plus notify notification pipeline
nodes.rationale: Database triggers write outbox rows and notify Edge Function claims batch atomically with merge rule and channel edit idempotency so notifications never block the main order flow.

nodes.label: Money rules v2 roundToStep
nodes.rationale: Float-safe roundToStep with epsilon fixes verified browser/server Snapp mismatch; SQL uses exact numeric math; invariant owe+h_share==net+shipping_fee asserted in code and tests.

nodes.label: Product model no cost no stock availability toggle
nodes.norm_label: product model no cost no stock availability toggle
nodes.rationale: Remove cost/stock/private tables to eliminate secret numbers between partners; availability is a blocker not a warning and archive preserves old order product names.

nodes.label: Money model single source of truth
nodes.norm_label: money model single source of truth
nodes.rationale: All money math lives in one pure calc.js reused by UI and tests and mirrored by server create_order RPC; owe+h_share==total/payout invariants guarantee page-shop accounting consistency.

nodes.label: Pale Sage Green Rounded Square Palette
nodes.norm_label: pale sage green rounded square palette

nodes.label: Admin role (unreleased)
nodes.rationale: Promote current store login to admin with full access while mahdi slot stays empty; is_mahdi covers admin powers and is_admin gates admin-only controls including test-mode switch.

nodes.label: RLS membership security is_member
nodes.rationale: Public anon key requires membership check not just authenticated; every write via security-definer RPC keeps validation and history atomic; disable public sign-up.
